remarks: Welcome to this beautifully designed 4-bed, 3-bath, 1,895 sq ft detached home in the vibrant community of Alces, Edmonton. Built in 2026, every detail has been thoughtfully curated for modern living.  The main floor features a functional bedroom with full bath — perfect for guests or a home office plus a walk-through mudroom and pantry with built-in MDF shelving. The designer kitchen boasts 41 soft-close cabinets to the ceiling, quartz countertops, and overlooks the great room anchored by a stunning 50 linear electric fireplace. Upgraded spindle railing and 5000K LED disc lighting elevate the entire space, while durable Luxury Vinyl Plank flooring runs throughout the main floor, bathrooms, and laundry. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet and 4-piece ensuite with dual sinks and stand-up shower. Two additional bedrooms, a central bonus room, full bathroom, laundry, and premium 35oz carpet with 8lb underlay complete the second floor. A high-efficiency furnace. (id:67522)
